dp_barwoman.text: Welcome to the Eske. There's a session most nights and a quiz on a Tuesday, unless the session runs into the quiz, which it usually does.

dp_quizmaster.text: Quiz time! Five questions. No phones, no conferring, and no shouting the answers to the next table, Seán.
Fancy a round? Five questions, no phones.

else.text: Grand. Your seat will be warm when you come back. It's beside the fire.

dp_trawlerman.text: I fish out of Killybegs. Mackerel, herring, blue whiting. We land more fish there than anywhere else in Ireland, and the gulls know it.
Smoked mackerel, now. Best breakfast there is. Fight me.

dp_singer.text: This one's about a ship that left from the bay for America, and everybody on the quay crying. Most of our songs are about somebody leaving. The rest are about somebody coming home.

donegal_pub_darts.text: Board's in the corner, darts are in the tin, and the oche is that bit of tape the cleaner keeps trying to lift.
